title: Do benign steering vectors silently erode safety? A replication and audit

original_idea.body: Reproduce a slice of the Safety Pitfalls of Steering Vectors audit on a small open model: extract benign CAA vectors and measure ASR change on a jailbreak subset.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Concrete safety-externality threat for open-community practitioners; defensible chain to a risky-direction checklist.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: CAA extraction from benign datasets + AdvBench subset + refusal classifier; standard tools, beginner-feasible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped replication: 4-6 vectors, fixed strength, ASR change on 50 prompts.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Consumer-hardware audit for hobbyists, diffuse-reward infra labs deprioritize; public data, no internal access.

low_compute.reasoning: 7-8B inference on a small benchmark; single consumer GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Largely a replication of a published audit on small models; the core finding is already established.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: This is an explicit replication of a recent published audit; the main result is already shown, with a small-model extension.
